```{r}
Idents(seurat_monocytes) <- "cluster_combined"
#plan(strategy = "multisession")



# seurat_monocytes_markers<- FindAllMarkers(seurat_monocytes#,max.cells.per.ident = 400
#                                           )
# seurat_monocytes_markers %>% write_rds(paste0(path_data_file, "seurat_monocytes_markers.rds"))
seurat_monocytes_markers <- read_rds(paste0(path_data_file, "seurat_monocytes_markers.rds") )
plan('sequential')

additional_markers_mono<- FindAllMarkers(seurat_monocytes,
                                         features = genes_manual_select_1,
                                         logfc.threshold = 0,
                                         min.pct = 0,
                                         return.thresh = 1)





seurat_monocytes_markers %>% filter(!(str_detect(gene, pattern = "RP")), avg_log2FC>0) %>% group_by(cluster) %>% slice_min(p_val_adj, n=30)
seurat_monocytes_markers <- seurat_monocytes_markers %>%  mutate(cluster=factor(cluster, levels =c("Classical_Monocytes",
                                           "Non_classical_Monocytes",
                                           "HLA_DRhi_CD83_Monocytes",
                                           "HLA_DRlo_s100a_Monocytes",
                                           "CD163hi_Monocytes_donor1_day1") )) 
seurat_monocytes_markers_add <- seurat_monocytes_markers %>% as_tibble()%>%  bind_rows(as_tibble(additional_markers_mono)) %>% select(-p_val,-p_val_adj) %>% distinct(gene,cluster, .keep_all = T)
```

```{r}
Idents(seurat_monocytes) <- "cluster_combined"
seurat_monocytes_clean <- subset(seurat_monocytes,
                           idents= "CD163hi_Monocytes_donor1_day1",
                           invert=TRUE)
seurat_monocytes_clean <- seurat_monocytes
markers_final <- genes_manual_select_1 <- c(
  "HLA-DRA", "HLA-DRB1", "FYB",
  "FCGR3A", "FCER1G","CX3CR1",
  "ITGAL",  "C1QA",  
  "CD83","IFI27","IFI44L", "IRF1","IL1B", 
  "S100A8", "S100A9", "S100A12",
  "SELL",
  "CD163", "CD14")
final_markers<- FindAllMarkers(seurat_monocytes_clean,
                                         features = markers_final,
                                         logfc.threshold = 0,
                                         min.pct = 0,
                                         return.thresh = 1)

final_markers <- final_markers %>%  mutate(cluster=factor(cluster, levels =c("Classical_Monocytes",
                                           "Non_classical_Monocytes",
                                           "HLA_DRhi_CD83_Monocytes",
                                           "HLA_DRlo_s100a_Monocytes") )) 



final_markers%>% 
#seurat_monocytes_markers %>% 
  # mutate(gene=str_replace_all(gene,"-", ""))%>%
  #   mutate(pct.1=ifelse(gene=="HLADRA",2,pct.1)) %>% 
  filter(gene %in% genes_manual_select_1) %>% 
  mutate(gene=factor(gene, levels =genes_manual_select_1 )) %>% 
  # arrange(gene) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(cluster, gene,size=pct.1, color=avg_log2FC))+
  geom_point()+
  scale_color_gradient2(midpoint=0, low="blue", mid="grey",high="red", space ="Lab" ) +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust=1))+
          scale_color_carto_c(name = "average log2/n fold change: ",
                           type = "diverging", palette = "Geyser", direction = 1)
```

```{r}
seurat_monocytes_markers %>% subset(cluster=="Classical_Monocytes") %>% 
  distinct(gene,.keep_all = T)%>% filter(pct.1>0.6)%>%  arrange(-avg_log2FC )

seurat_monocytes_markers %>% subset(cluster=="Classical_Monocytes") %>% 
  distinct(gene,.keep_all = T)%>% mutate(pct_dif=pct.2-pct.1) %>%  filter(pct_dif>0.2 )%>%  arrange(-avg_log2FC )

seurat_monocytes_markers %>% filter(str_detect(cluster,"CD83")) %>% 
  distinct(gene,.keep_all = T)%>% mutate(pct_dif=pct.2-pct.1) %>%  #filter(pct_dif>0.2 )%>% 
  arrange(-avg_log2FC )
```
```{r}
seurat_monocytes_clean
gene_sums <- slot(seurat_monocytes_clean, "assays")[["RNA"]] %>% slot("counts") %>%  sparse_Sums(rowSums=T)
gene_sums_tbl <- tibble(gene=rownames(seurat_monocytes_clean), gene_sums=gene_sums) %>% mutate(gene=fct_reorder(gene, -gene_sums)) %>% slice_max(gene_sums, n=100) %>% mutate(is_S100A8=case_when(gene=="S100A8"~"S100A8",gene=="S100A9"~"S100A9", gene=="S100A12"~"S100A12", TRUE~"other")) %>% arrange(-gene_sums) %>% mutate(rank=rank(desc(gene_sums)))
gene_sums_tbl
gene_sums_tbl%>%  ggplot(aes(gene,gene_sums, fill=is_S100A8))+geom_col()

```
